about_the_game:
Silver Wings puts you in the cockpit of WW2 era aircraft, commanding the skies and your own forces as you choose your approach to multi-stage operations influenced by real historical events. Recruit every pilot, every tank driver, every ship captain - customize each of their vehicles and build your squadron however you see fit.

Key Features:

  • Choose your own approach with multi-stage operations - pick your targets for each stage, choose which units are involved and their designated targets.

  • Take to the skies in a range of aircraft from World War II - from fast fighters like the Spitfire or Zero to the destruction-raining Lancaster, naval aircraft like the Beaufort and plenty more to influence the operation yourself and command your troops from the air.

  • Command land, air and naval forces, recruiting every pilot, customizing every vehicle. Squadron members gain experience with the weapons they use, gaining useful perks. Experienced members can become commanders of each squadron, providing powerful boosts that depend on their personal experience and skills, providing a huge variety of ways to build your squadrons strength however you see fit.
